to-name: To William Butler Bourn

Miss Yonge is much obliged to [Mr Bourn](/person/178) for sending her several reviews and critical notices of [Hopes & Fears](/book/37).
She would be glad to know how the sale of the work has been proceeding.
Miss Yonge would be much obliged if Mr Bourn would inform her whether [Mr Parker](/person/1144) is pretty well, and also to express to him her sincere regrets and condolence[^1]


[^1]: His son [John William Parker](/person/1143), Jr. (1820-1860) had died on 9 November. Bourn and the elder Parker were now running the firm.
